column1: # NIST CCVS producer->consumer chains - the ONE chain source of truth (never re-encode this topology elsewhere).
# One line per CONSUMER: <consumer> <pred1> <pred2> ...  (predecessors in run order; '#' starts a comment).
# A consumer's first op on the shared TF### file is OPEN INPUT/I-O of a file its predecessors create, so the
# harness must compile+run the predecessors in the consumer's OWN working directory first (isolated, start-clean;
# every chain's FIRST member re-creates its TF### via OPEN OUTPUT, so chains are self-sufficient - the legacy
# guard's cross-chain "MUST stay consecutive" ordering constraints do not apply here).
# Derived from the per-unit X-card ASSIGN map (scout brief st-chain-brief.md SS2, 2026-06-10); both the
# differential harness (NistDifferentialTests) and the sweep (sweep-one.sh) read THIS file.
